content.title: Best Stock Trade of 2025 Keeps Running, Question Is for How Long
content.summary: Memory and storage companies were the leading performers in the S&P 500 Index last year, as the massive amounts of cash being spent on building out AI infrastructure trickled down to some traditionally staid parts of the tech sector.  Sandisk popped 16% on the first trading day of the year and then soared 28% on Tuesday after Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang highlighted the need for more memory and storage in the AI ecosystem.  Meanwhile, Western Digital, Seagate and Micron have all posted double-digit percentage gains to start 2026, although all three stocks fell on Wednesday.
